name: io.github.Helios-One-Oy/odoo-mcp
title: Odoo
description: Odoo orders, late lines, supplier promise dates, manufacturing and stock. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: ODOO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Odoo API key for that user (or set ODOO_PASSWORD instead)

environmentVariables.name: ODOO_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Odoo password, if no API key is used

environmentVariables.name: ODOO_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow the one write tool (still needs a confirmation text per call)
